measures.title: Renewal of the Save Our Indian River Lagoon Half-Cent Sales Tax
measures.summary: Asks whether Brevard County should renew its existing Save Our Indian River Lagoon half-cent sales tax for ten years. The money would fund infrastructure, capital improvements, capital maintenance projects and programs to improve water quality and fish and wildlife habitat, remove muck, and reduce pollution in the lagoon. All revenue would go to a trust fund used only for those purposes, with citizen committee oversight and annual independent audits.
measures.yesMeans: The Save Our Indian River Lagoon half-cent sales tax is renewed for ten years.
measures.noMeans: The Save Our Indian River Lagoon half-cent sales tax is not renewed.

measures.title: Renewal of Ad Valorem Millage to Sustain Increased Teacher Pay and Other Purposes
measures.summary: Asks whether the School Board should renew a one-mill property tax for four years. The money would sustain increased teacher and staff pay, fund technical training for students, and similar purposes, with funds shared with charter schools based on enrollment and spending reviewed by an independent citizens' oversight committee.
measures.yesMeans: The School Board's one-mill property tax is renewed for four years.
measures.noMeans: The School Board's one-mill property tax is not renewed.

measures.title: Renewal of Half-Cent Sales Surtax for Critical School Facility, Security, and Technology Upgrades
measures.summary: Asks whether the half-cent school sales surtax approved by voters in 2014 and 2020 should be renewed for ten years. The money would continue school facility projects, school security improvements and technology upgrades, with revenue shared with charter schools based on enrollment and spending reviewed by an independent citizens' oversight committee.
measures.yesMeans: The half-cent school sales surtax is renewed for ten years.
measures.noMeans: The half-cent school sales surtax is not renewed.

measures.id: City of Palm Bay Charter Amendment
measures.title: Charter Amendment Related to the Process for Filling Vacancies on the City Council
measures.summary: Would amend section 3.062 of the Palm Bay City Charter on City Council vacancies. If 12 months or less remain in the unexpired term, the remaining council members could fill the vacancy by appointment; if more than 12 months remain, the vacancy would be filled by election.
measures.yesMeans: Council vacancies would be filled by appointment when 12 months or less remain in the term, and by election when more than 12 months remain.
measures.noMeans: Section 3.062 of the City Charter is not amended and the current vacancy process stays in place.
